d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Vietnam vs Mali in Group G of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Mali secured a 2-0 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha as Sanaba Keita broke the deadlock in the second half and Djigui Koïta sealed it late on. Mali top Group G with a perfect nine points, while Vietnam finish third and must wait to see if they advance as one of the best third-placed teams.
